performance_claim.reason: No corrected fullrun was authorized or executed. This layer changes cost measurement, not strategy alpha.

adv20_usd.corporate_action_rule: Do not multiply adjusted close by unadjusted volume

half_spread.estimator: Corwin-Schultz two-day high-low full spread divided by two

paper_slippage.side_policy: Only explicit BUY or SELL rows are accepted; missing, blank, or unknown sides cannot act as wildcard evidence
paper_slippage.timestamp_normalization: Every timestamp-bearing date alias is converted to America/New_York before its trade date is derived
paper_slippage.plain_date_policy: A literal YYYY-MM-DD is already a trade date and remains unchanged

target_fill_coverage.required: Every non-cash target transition, including removed-name liquidation, must have its configured fill within max_fill_lag_days
target_fill_coverage.applies_to: fixed-bps control and dynamic-cost research replay
target_fill_coverage.evidence_cutoff_policy: A transition whose actual fill, or earliest possible fill when no actual fill exists, is after evidence_end_date is audited as pending and is not required for the clamped replay
target_fill_coverage.operating_book_cutoff_inference: When no explicit cutoff is supplied, accept only build_operating_target_books metadata where operating_appended is true, the signal date equals operating_latest_price_date, and no later target row exists
target_fill_coverage.pre_cutoff_missing_fill_policy: Any transition that could have filled on or before evidence_end_date remains required and blocks when its fill is missing or asynchronous
target_fill_coverage.pending_only_non_cash_policy: A non-cash book with no replayable transition at or before the evidence cutoff remains incomplete
target_fill_coverage.cash_only_policy: A cash-only book has zero non-cash transition requirements and is vacuously complete; its cash calendar is validated separately when carry is enabled

dynamic_cost_affordability.method: monotone binary search against the original desired quantity

research_cost_contract.missing_liquidity_paper_slippage_policy: base cost plus max(600bps variable ceiling, observed paper slippage)
research_cost_contract.source_manifest_target_policy: Price-source requirements use replay-filtered target_fill_coverage rows whose required_for_replay flag is true; raw excluded target variants and post-evidence pending transitions remain separately audited
research_cost_contract.blocked_nested_artifact_policy: Remove equity, holdings, cash, position, and account-state artifacts; retain redacted metrics and trade-level cost audit except out-of-bounds paper slippage removes trades too

promotion_prerequisites: 100% execution-cost coverage for all trades used by the metric
100% configured fill coverage for every replay-required non-cash target transition including liquidation
one chronology-safe actual fill date per synchronous portfolio transition
Every non-cash target ticker has a hashed, loadable OHLCV price-cache source
paper slippage plus base cost remains strictly below 10000bps
paper slippage does not structurally exceed the modeled assumption
economic meaning remains at 0.1%, 0.5%, and 1.0% ADV scenarios
corrected champion and challenger use the same target-book hash and cost configuration
separate human approval after OOS and multiple-testing gates

references.title: Corwin and Schultz (2012), A Simple Way to Estimate Bid-Ask Spreads from Daily High and Low Prices
Market impact and trading profile of large trading orders in stock markets
SEC Rule 605 amendments on execution quality
